name: BeforeAfter
description: An interactive before/after image comparison component with a draggable shutter slider. Can display side-by-side without shutter or with interactive shutter overlay.

props.name: beforeLabel
props.description: Label displayed on the before image

props.name: afterLabel
props.description: Label displayed on the after image

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the comparison container in pixels

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the comparison container in pixels

props.name: showShutter
props.description: Show interactive shutter slider (true) or side-by-side view (false)

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes for the container

features: Interactive shutter slider with mouse and touch support
Accessible labels for before and after
accessibility: Keyboard and touch support via mouse events
